tools.description:
Return first-setup instructions and clickable App Store and Google Play
    download links, for when you do not have the human's Call Me number yet.
    Show both links to the human as clickable links, then ask them to open My
    Number in the app and give you its 10 digits. Nothing is sent and not

tools.name: call
tools.description:
Ring the human's phone (iPhone or Android), read `question` aloud word
    for word, and return what they say back as text. Waits up to ~30s.

    status "completed" carries their words in `transcript` (empty if they only
    listened). "ringing" (not picked up yet) or "in_call" (listening) means th

tools.name: poll_result
tools.description:
Check on a call that came back "ringing", "in_call" or "playing". Waits
    up to ~25s for it to settle, then returns the same shape as `call`: the
    final status and transcript once they answer, decline, or the ring times
    out ("missed", within about a minute). Still not settled: call it again

tools.name: play_audio
tools.description:
Bigger and longer audio goes here. Calls the human and plays a
    recording to them as a phone call: a podcast, a long narration you
    rendered, a voice memo, music. `source` is a link (YouTube, SoundCloud, a
    podcast page, or a direct .mp3/.m4a/.wav/.ogg/.flac/... link) or the
    audio_id of

tools.name: say
tools.description:
In a call whose result came back "open": true, speak `text` to the human
    and return what they answer, in the same shape as `call`. Only after their
    previous answer is in. Waits up to ~30s; on "in_call", follow up with
    poll_result. "open": false means the call has ended. Pass `language` o

tools.name: hang_up
tools.description:
End a call you placed. In an open conversation `goodbye` is spoken
    first; leave it empty to just hang up. A call that already ended reports
    its final status.

tools.name: text
tools.description:
Send a one-way text to the human's phone (a push notification, no
    ring). Use it for updates that need no answer, or as the fallback when a
    call comes back "missed" or "declined". delivered:false means it was saved
    to their history but no notification showed; `notice` says why. Their

tools.name: wait_for_reply
tools.description:
Wait for the human to send something back to this session — texts and
    voicemail transcripts arrive here. Long-polls up to wait_s (max 30s);
    returns {events, cursor}. Pass the returned cursor next time to only see
    new events. An empty events list just means nothing yet — poll again if

tools.name: set_thread_title
tools.description:
Name this session's conversation thread on the human's phone (e.g. the
    project or task you are working on). Shown as the thread title in the app.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call, poll_result, wait_for_reply · Private data: play_audio · Public sink: call, text, wait_for_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: call, poll_result, wait_for_reply · Private data: play_audio · Public sink: call, text, wait_for_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "call" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
